rule: No development in NCR may violate the Regional Plan; the NCRPB Act overrides other non-conforming Acts and rules (NCRPB Act, Sections 29 and 27).
Rules, byelaws, policies and plans are made under the Act and cannot go beyond it.
source: UP Urban Planning and Development Act 1973

rule: State sectoral policies prevail over the building byelaws where the two differ (clause 1.6).
Zonal development plans are prepared for zones of the development area under the master plan; development must be in accordance with these plans (Sections 9 and 14).
source: UP Urban Planning and Development Act 1973

rule: Development, including projects, must be in accordance with the master plan and zonal plan; a separate procedure applies to government departments (Section 14).
source: UP Urban Planning and Development Act 1973

rule: Two plans at the same level each bind only their own area. A difference between them is settled by amending a plan (Section 13: the Authority for minor changes, the State Government for any change) or by State Government direction (Section 41), within the Regional Plan.
source: UP Urban Planning and Development Act 1973

rule: The 2025 byelaws prevail over the earlier orders and byelaws listed in their Appendix-1 (clause 1.5).
